topic: Unlocking Planar Graphs: Euler's Formula and Duality
target_audience: University students (Computer Science or Discrete Mathematics)

sections.title: Prerequisite: Defining the Planar Graph
lecture_lines: Planar graphs avoid any edge crossings.
Vertices are dots; edges are lines.
Faces are enclosed or infinite regions.
animations: Create a set of points in the plane using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dots.svg].
Draw non-intersecting edges between points to form a graph using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lines.svg].
Highlight edges to distinguish from faces.

sections.title: Euler’s Characteristic Formula
lecture_lines: Euler's formula connects V, E, and F.
For connected planar graphs, V - E + F = 2.
This value remains constant under distortion.
Verify this for the K4 graph.
The formula balances perfectly at two.

sections.title: The Concept of Duality
lecture_lines: Duality builds a new graph structure.
Place a vertex inside every face.
Connect vertices if faces share edges.
animations: Place a node in the center of each face.
Connect nodes across edges to form dual graph.

sections.title: The Duality Connection
lecture_lines: Original graph edges map to dual edges.
This duality reveals core graph relationships.
animations: Overlay dual graph onto original graph using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg].
Show dual vertices mapping to original faces.
Animate dual edges crossing original edges.

sections.title: Application: Network Resilience
lecture_lines: Duality aids in network resilience analysis.
Identify redundant paths in infrastructure maps.
Reinforce critical junctions to improve reliability.
animations: Display a connected network graph using nodes represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/server.svg].
Simulate edge removal between [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/router.svg] nodes to show failure paths.
Use dual graph to highlight critical edges connected by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cables.svg].
